translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Tu omi wakalivamiyao wavanenega tu ganagahe. Yaubada yana vedewayauga ana tova giyemuyemu. Tu omiꞋiyao ma hida tova ana abalauyabu liline mani giba tulina tulina waꞋiveꞋaveꞋahina. Yami miyami hidei babiya ma yami walokoloko wamimiyami. Gavadi gavadi taumiyao yami vemwamwala faꞋina nuwanuwami, medema wavaina. Taumiyao ahe waveꞋahiyauwami be agolaufofola ana tova faꞋina au kikidewadewamiyao. Kaliva yadi koyona keke ma tovedewayauga againe wasimanedi be agolaufofola giveledi faꞋina mema omi waluveꞋalikadi, badi keke tamo yadi abafaiwala yo taudiyao hinalugolegoledi amanadi. WaꞋitami! Tofaisewa yami faheya hififaisewa-ma keke fatadi wadaveleveledi. Fatadi keke faꞋina yadi tagiꞋalawoluwolu maꞋi wanoganogalina o kaꞋi keke? Badi yami faha ana toyaudi waveyawaiꞋalagolohidi-ma yadi tagiya Kaiwabu Tofaiwala-moꞋa ahe ginogalina. Medema faꞋina aseꞋuꞋaulolo lakahina ginayemaunimi, faꞋina wanatagitagi wanatagitagi taumiyao wanatagiꞋuvami. Yami giba kikaiwabuna wasenuwauluyena-ma gikoyo, tumotumo ami vaigau hiꞋana. Yami mani yami lokoloko waꞋiveꞋaveꞋahina be giduva-kawowo ma ahe gikoyo, ada yadi koyo againe taumiyao yami nuwanuwa koyona higa mali kaliva yami kikaiwabu againe keke wadavelugadi-ma giꞋiveyemaunina. Au aiꞋalaꞋalata omi taumiyao kadu yami kikaiwabu buye ginaꞋalahi-Ꞌowomi.
Yada waꞋatuvefaꞋila Kaiwabu yana yewaꞋela kanalulubodena.

Tu omi tobohiyakweyao gilubodami be wanaꞋatuvefaꞋila wananunauwena tu Kaiwabu yana yewaꞋela ana toveya. Tofaha yada abaꞋita. Badi tofaha yadi waꞋatuvefaꞋila wehi faꞋina hiboda tu ahe yadi babi gilugana yadi otova hifahana. Himiyami tu kadu wehi hinafane faꞋina hiboda be aꞋa ginatabo faꞋina. Lauva tunugina yadi waꞋatuvefaꞋila hibodaboda tu aꞋa maꞋinuwana maꞋinuwana gitabotabo tu muliya guwana yamumu-moꞋena hinayaudi.
Meda anafaiweya omi wanaꞋatuvefaꞋila aseꞋasemi wanakivevatuna faꞋina Kaiwabu yana yewaꞋela giluvedaꞋufo.
Tobohiyakweyao, keke taumiyao agaimiya wanaꞋalawoluwolu be higa keke matahiwadi wananuhagani faꞋina. WaꞋita! Tovedewayauga edaꞋawana liline gimidikebukebu.

KaduꞋe tobohiyakweyao, nuwami ginanauna falofita Kaiwabu ana eganeya Yaubada bonana hiꞋawatalatalainena-ma agaidiya. Badi yami abaꞋita vita tulina tulina agaidiya hiꞋatuvefaꞋila amine, meda omi wanaꞋatuvefaꞋila.

Yadi eda givita ana toveya hiꞋatuvefaꞋila faꞋina kavewagadi kaliva yadi wavemwamwala. Kadu abaꞋita saꞋeyana ma Yobi yana wanuwavita lakahina tu yana vetumagana againe giꞋatuvefaꞋila-moꞋa ma valeyana ahe wanogalina, kadu wahalamanena Kaiwabu yana vevai hagihagina Yobi faꞋina kahihina ana abalauyabu. Kaiwabu agobika kadu hinekalikali againe gimaga faꞋina, Yobi nuwakabubu lakahina ginuhagana.

Tu tobohiyakweyao, huluva saꞋeyana giluboda-moꞋemi. Wanawonadabadaba againe, keke tamo gavadi kikaiwabuna wanayakahini higa vaita yami wonadabadaba ana kivetoyoga faꞋina. Keke lobama o babi o gavadi kikaiwabudiyao wanayakahidi. Gavaimi wanahuluva kaꞋi velemoꞋena digo, “Ehe” wanayakahina. KaꞋi keke wanahuluvini digo, meda “Keke” wanayakahina. Tu keke egana “Tamada” amine wanamaduyakahini be higa mena egana ana aiyakata againe yami gahe kaꞋi aimo keke wanaꞋitaveꞋavini digo, Yaubada yana matahiwadi keke wananuhagani.
KaꞋi mene tamo kaliva amihinafeya giꞋaseꞋuꞋaulolo? Gilubodana be gidaveꞋoꞋola. KaꞋi mene tamo kaliva yana wavemwamwala? Gilubodana be gidakwelidavadava.
Kadu kaꞋi mene tamo kaliva amihinafeya giꞋaulolo? Gilubodana be ekelesiya adi tonagona gidakovadi be higa hinaveꞋoꞋolena ada bunama againe Kaiwabu ana eganeya hinabunamina.
Yadi wavetumagana toꞋaulolo hinaveꞋoꞋolena ada yadi veꞋoꞋola wavetumaganina againe toꞋaulolo ginabwaina. E, Kaiwabu ginasiveyawana. Ada kaꞋi gavadi koyona gifaisewadi, au Kaiwabu ginayawelidi.

Au mema yami koyona taumiyao wanaveꞋaꞋiyauyauga kadu buye wanaveꞋaveꞋoveꞋoꞋola be higa aulolo againe yami yamumu wananuhagana. Hai kaliva yana dewa yegayegana tu ginaveꞋoꞋola, medema yana veꞋoꞋola ana wafaiwala kadu waguwana.

WaꞋita, bana Elaiya kaliva anafaiweya ide kaliva, ana ayauna meda anafaiweya ide ada ayauna, ada giveꞋoꞋoladonadona vaita keke maꞋita wehi ginahobu. Ada malamala tohiye kadu hafuna keke-moꞋa maꞋi wehi gidahobuhobu.
Kadu giveꞋoꞋola-havagi vaita wehi ginalugaga ada au Yaubada wehi givetalaiyeni-yo babi ana gaitoma moyaꞋaina givebutu gitabotabo.

Kafoi tobohiyakweyao, hida gahe nuwami ginanunauyena. KaꞋi tobohiyami saꞋeyana Yaubada yana nuwanuwa velemoꞋena ana eda ginanufaniyena ada tamo hakwadi edai-nadi againe ginavaiyewena be yana dewa koyona ginavekwaulaugena, mena toveluga bana tobohiyana alikeya ahe gikibababalena ada bana tokoyona yana koyona moyaꞋaina ana aiyawela ginuhagana. (Iya Yemesa bonaku.)
